purpose: Free project-owned baseline weight storage only after the complete local reproduction evidence is independently retained and the identical immutable model remains rematerializable.
retained_reproduction_bundle: dataset identity, split manifest, and source-unit ordering
source repository identity, commit, dirty-tree state, and applied patch or overlay hashes
resolved configuration, prompts, seeds, environment lock, hardware mapping, and launch command with secrets removed
all predictions, session records, QA records, raw metric records, sufficient statistics, and seed-level values
stdout, stderr, timing, resource observations, failure records, and terminal sentinels
postprocessed method and slice summaries without favorable-unit deletion
archive manifests, complete archive SHA-256 values, and transfer receipts
pre-download and post-download model manifests including every relative file path, byte size, and SHA-256
protected_assets: all pre-existing or shared models, caches, datasets, source checkouts, environments, results, logs, manifests, and archives
cleanup_preconditions_all_required: Every lifecycle and full numerical run associated with the model is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and has no contradictory rejection sentinel.
Expected run, seed, sample, prediction, and metric cardinalities match the frozen manifests; failed or missing registered units are retained under the frozen missing-run rule.
Postprocessing and result-row validation are TERMINAL_ACCEPTED before any cleanup eligibility audit begins.
The complete evidence archive is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED on a storage root outside the model target and an independent read-only audit verifies every archive SHA-256 and required member.

The retained pre-download manifest binds a public or otherwise still-accessible repository, immutable revision, access condition, exact target, allow-patterns, expected file count, and expected byte total.
The retained post-download manifest binds the resolved revision plus every relative model file path, byte size, and SHA-256.
A fresh hash audit proves the on-disk model matches the retained post-download manifest immediately before quarantine.
The exact target resolves beneath one eligible_weight_root, is not a symlink, mount point, bind mount, shared cache, dataset, environment, source checkout, run root, result root, or archive root.
A read-only process audit finds no command line, memory map, current working directory, root directory, or open file descriptor referencing the exact model target.
A project reference audit attributes the target only to the accepted reproduction family and its retained manifests; no active or pending run depends on it.
The cleanup record is fully rendered and validated in DRY_RUN_ELIGIBLE state before any rename or deletion.

two_phase_cleanup.phase_1: Atomically rename the exact target on the same filesystem to a unique project-owned quarantine path recorded with original device, inode, file count, and byte count.
two_phase_cleanup.phase_1_gate: Repeat the no-process-reference and retained-evidence checks against both original and quarantine paths; any discrepancy stops with the quarantine retained.
two_phase_cleanup.phase_2: Delete only the explicit resolved quarantine path, without globs, shell expansion, symlink traversal, or recursive targets derived from environment variables.
two_phase_cleanup.postcondition: Verify that both original and quarantine paths are absent while every retained run, result, manifest, and archive path remains present and hash-valid.

cleanup_record_required: model repository, immutable revision, materialization record, and materialization-record SHA-256
associated lifecycle, numerical run, postprocess, and archive identities
archive paths, archive SHA-256 values, and independent verification timestamp
pre-cleanup device, inode, file count, byte count, and complete current model hash result
phase-1 rename result, phase-2 deletion result, and post-delete absence checks
post-delete retained-evidence presence and hash checks
fail_closed_rules: A rejected, incomplete, missing, ambiguous, or unaudited reproduction never authorizes cleanup.
A private, gated, deleted, mutable-only, or no-longer-accessible model repository never qualifies as rematerializable without a separately retained lawful weight archive.
A model used by more than one reproduction may be deleted only after every dependent reproduction is accepted, archived, and retired from active or pending execution.
A failed archive, failed transfer, hash mismatch, active process reference, target collision, or path ambiguity stops cleanup without deleting the quarantine.
No cleanup outcome is evidence of model quality and no storage decision may change admitted numerical results.
